AccountMailSettings.description: Sanitized owner-only mailbox configuration. Endpoint has no password field.

features.description: Last verified server capabilities, when recorded at enrollment or reconnect.

folders.description: Recently listed folders, including manually excluded folders.

helpUrl.description: Official instructions supplied by the catalog.

imap.description: Incoming mail server, security mode and username.

provider.description: Catalog name for the provider, when known.

smtp.description: Submission server, security mode and username.

action.description: Provider-neutral MessageAction, using its existing serde format.

AttachmentInput.description: Metadata and bytes for an app attachment.

dataBase64.description: Encoded bytes (empty when creating a resumable upload).

Binding.description: Exact mailbox credential binding, authorized by the email domain.

removed.description: Ids removed from this folder only.

Classification.description: Provider feedback is metadata. It is never proof that a matching outbound send succeeded.

complaint.description: RFC 5965 complaint or supported vendor complaint.

delivery.description: RFC 3464 recipient results, preserving recipients with different outcomes.

originalMessageId.description: Message-ID of the original message from attached headers, if present.

Complaint.description: Fields of an Abuse Reporting Format feedback report.

feedbackType.description: Feedback-Type such as abuse, fraud or opt-out.

recipients.description: Distinct original recipients in provider-reported order.

ConnectRequest.description: Promote verified credentials into a persisted account.

DeliveryReport.description: Delivery status for one original recipient.

action.description: Failed, delayed, delivered, relayed, or expanded.

Discovery.description: Mailbox-independent provider settings returned without accepting a password.

hostConfirmationRequired.description: Explicit endpoint confirmation is required before sending any password.

steer.description: Steer to an existing OAuth provider.

DiscoverySteer.description: Closed provider guidance; password connections remain a separate user choice.

Draft.description: Versioned draft metadata consumed by the existing coordinator.

id.description: Move-stable id shared by the eventual Sent copy.

isDraft.description: False once submission has been accepted.

content.description: Serialized SendRequest; retains its original source-of-truth type.

username.description:
Raw protocol login: providers may require a local part or account ID
rather than an email address.

Error.description: Only closed, non-sensitive failure classes cross the HTTP boundary.

ErrorBody.description: Closed error body for generated callers.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Minimum backoff for a retryable refusal.

Folder.description: A physical IMAP folder, with an opaque stable identity.

name.description: Display name; transport preserves the original name separately.

parentId.description: Parent when represented by the hierarchy.

syncEnabled.description: Catalog entries remain available for filing even when their change stream is disabled.

FolderRole.description: Physical folder purpose, resolved by the engine.

FolderSetting.description: Folder name and the actual and configured routing roles, without message data.

detectedRole.description: Automatic role before applying the user's override.

effectiveRole.description: Resolved destination used by the engine.

excluded.description: Whether the user has excluded this folder from message sync.

id.description: Opaque identifier belonging to this account.

monitored.description: Whether this folder was included in the latest synchronization.

name.description: Display name from the most recent listing.

roleOverride.description: Explicit user choice. An absent value uses the detected role.

watched.description: Whether this folder is selected for a dedicated watch.

Login.description: Credentials for one protocol; Debug never includes the password.

password.description: Protocol password, kept distinct for providers with separate SMTP credentials.

Message.description: Readable message representation; MIME is decoded by the provider adapter.

classification.description: Observed provider delivery/feedback evidence, never a submission acknowledgment.

draftCorrelation.description: Stable Macro id for an app-created sent message.

mimeBase64.description: Raw RFC 5322 source, base64 encoded for HTTP transport.

size.description: Remote RFC822.SIZE (the full source is downloaded lazily).

sourceComplete.description: True only for a full source response or an app-sent fallback snapshot.

Operation.description: Typed account operation. The service validates every referenced id inside the link.

oneOf.description: Append the next byte range or retry an already accepted range.
Submit once; uncertain admission is sticky across crashes.

OperationClass.description: Trusted caller workload, independent from mailbox authorization or rollout.

Secret.description: Password held only for one connection or encrypted immediately.

ServerFeatures.description: Negotiated capability flags. Provider banners and EHLO arguments are never retained.

gmailExtensions.description: Incoming server advertises Gmail's IMAP extension.

moveMessages.description: Incoming server supports the MOVE command.

objectId.description: Incoming server supplies RFC 8474 object identifiers.

sendLimitBytes.description: Server-advertised positive SIZE limit in bytes.

uidPlus.description: Incoming server supports per-UID copy and expunge receipts.

verifiedAt.description: When both authenticated endpoints last answered the capability check.

SubmissionOutcome.description: Submission acknowledgment. Unknown must never be retried automatically.

TlsMode.description: Required TLS mode. There is deliberately no plaintext variant.

UpdateFolderSettings.description: Replace all routing overrides atomically. A stale revision returns a conflict.

expectedRevision.description: Version returned by the last settings read.

roleOverrides.description: Empty map restores automatic folder routing.

watchedFolderIds.description: At most one extra included folder may hold a live IDLE watcher.

id.description: Opaque upload id, never a caller-chosen HTTP target.

expiresAt.description: Expiry after which a new verification is required.

id.description: Promotion token, never usable for a different owner.

VerifyRequest.description: Both endpoints required to create an account.

confirmedHosts.description: Hosts explicitly confirmed by the user before sending credentials.

email.description: Address already verified by Macro sign-in or a mailbox challenge.
